raw_evidence_sections.text: Application Program Start Formalities and Examinations IGC's full-time MBA and master's programs in International Management Get your MBA or master's degree in International Management in less than two years! At International Graduate Center (IGC) we offer currently seven different full-time MBA and Master's programs in Bremen which is in the North of Germany only about one hour from Hamburg. Our programs are geared towards international management. Companies are increasingly operating globally, so international management is a central task for future executives. Find the full-time program of your choice! IGC in Bremen is a leading destination for students worldwide seeking a first-class education to advance their careers. As a renowned German institution in the higher education sector that champions academic excellence, both nationally and internationally, the IGC acts as a top destination for knowledge, innovation and professional development. Our institute is known for its commitment to providing a comprehensive educational experience that adapts to the ever-changing demands of the global business world.
